name: localsend-nas
description: Unofficial LocalSend node for NAS (not an official LocalSend project). Send files from your Unraid shares to any LocalSend device, and receive files into shares via the web UI — files never round-trip through your laptop. Speaks LocalSend Protocol v2.2. Clients can never browse the NAS: the web UI picks what gets sent, and received files land only in the share you choose. IMPORTANT: THIS TEMPLATE USES HOST NETWORKING ON PURPOSE — LocalSend discovers devices via multicast UDP 53317, which Docker bridge/NAT breaks. Do NOT switch to bridge: devices will stop finding each other automatically.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Device identity, settings.json and saved targets.

paths.name: User Shares
paths.description: Your Unraid shares, mounted 1:1 (host path = container path). rw so received files can be written. All entries in the Shares variable live under this mount.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: Web UI port. Host networking: no mapping, container port = host port.

ports.name: LocalSend
ports.description: LocalSend protocol port (HTTPS). Must be reachable by other devices.

ports.name: LocalSend discovery
ports.description: LocalSend discovery (multicast UDP). Required for auto-discovery.

variables.name: Shares
variables.description: Comma-separated name=path pairs shown as shares in the web UI. Because /mnt/user is mounted 1:1, paths match Unraid share paths — e.g. media=/mnt/user/media,photos=/mnt/user/photos. Edit this list to add or rename shares; no extra Path mappings needed.

variables.name: Listen
variables.description: Web UI listen address. Change the port if 8080 clashes with another app on the host; keep the WebUI Port entry in sync.

variables.name: Alias
variables.description: Name this NAS shows as in other devices' LocalSend lists.

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: User the app runs as (Unraid default 99 = nobody). Must have read access to your shares, and write access wherever you receive files.

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: Group the app runs as (Unraid default 100 = users).
